name: swap-button
title: Swap button
description: Swap two values with one press, like origin and destination or from and to: the icon turns, both fields trade places, and it says what changed.
docs: Give it labelA, labelB and the current values so it can say what changed. With seam it centres on its parent, which must be relative, and reaches (size minus gap) / 2 into each field: leave a 20px gap between fields padded 16px (gap-5) so it clears their text and its focus ring has room. swapValues(state, 'from', 'to') is a pure helper for the common two-field state.
